title: Hallmark verdict
description: The principal engineer's review of one frozen commit. List what breaks, with the scenario; rule on every open finding from earlier rounds; say which briefing learnings you used and whether they held. There is no approve field: Hallmark approves when no blocker or major finding stays open.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the change does and whether it is safe to ship.

findings.description: New problems found in this round. Empty when nothing is wrong.

severity.description: blocker: must not ship. major: a real defect that should be fixed first, including a changed behaviour no test pins. minor: worth fixing, not blocking. nit: style.

scenario.description: The concrete inputs or state, and the wrong result they produce.

pre_existing.description: True when the problem was there before this change (the base has the same code) and the change doesn't make it worse. It is recorded and shown, but never blocks approval and isn't the author's to fix.

prior.description: One ruling for each open finding listed in the prompt. Leave none out.

id.description: The finding's ID, such as F3.

status.description: withdrawn: the dispute is right, or the finding was wrong.

learnings.description: The briefing's learnings (L-0001…) that informed this review.

held.description: False when this change shows the learning is wrong or stale.

needs_person.description: Set only when a person should approve this change before it merges whatever the automated checks say: it changes what the system does in a way a reviewer can't fully judge (billing, auth, a release or CI workflow, data people can't get back, a pattern others will copy). One sentence saying why. Leave it out for an ordinary change; it is not a severity and never blocks the review.

examples.summary: Adds retries with jitter to webhook delivery. One race lets two workers deliver the same event.

findings.title: Two workers can retry the same delivery
findings.scenario: Workers A and B both read attempt 2 of delivery 17 before either writes; the endpoint receives event 17 twice.
findings.fix: Claim the delivery with SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED before sending.

examples.needs_person: It changes how webhooks are retried for every customer.
